title: Inside x402: 100M Agentic Payments on Base
author: Chainalysis
key_passages: x402 agentic transactions on Base went from near-zero in mid 2025 to well over 100 million cumulative transactions through Q1 2026
Transactions of $1+ now represent 95% of total volume transferred, up from 49% in early 2025
Much of the growth was driven by meme coin farming activity, particularly PING
x402 payers have an average wallet age of 197 days, compared to 423 days for the rest of Base
relevance: x402 adoption data, but notes much growth was speculative (meme coin) not commerce.
